voiceover.script: In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations across several regions before conservation efforts successfully helped them recover. Combined population numbers were estimated at small totals for specific rivers and basins located throughout Europe. Beavers live naturally in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds where they build dams. The keystone species concept became popular in conservation and was deployed to engender support for protecting damaged ecosystems. Conservation initiatives were mobilized where human activities had damaged ecosystems, especially by removing vital keystone predators. In addition, wolves often kept animals from grazing in riparian areas, which protected beavers from having food sources encroached upon. Ecological engineering uses ecology and engineering to predict, design, construct or restore, and manage ecosystems for mutual benefit. These engineered ecosystems integrate human society with its natural environment for the benefit of both balanced living systems.
